description: How many days, sleeps, weeks, working days and seconds are left until Christmas, Christmas Eve, New Year, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Thanksgiving, Easter, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Orthodox Christmas or your own date, counted in the time zone you give (IANA name, e.g. Europe/Berlin). Returns the exact date and weekday, a ready sentence ('38 days until Christmas'), a days/hours/minutes/seconds split and the next 3 dates of the event (Black Friday and Easter move every year). Own calendar code, 0 AI, nothing stored, under 5 ms. For chat bots, shop banners, newsletters, smart displays and school or office apps. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/countdown-days-until.

date.description: Your own date YYYY-MM-DD (with event=custom; today up to 10 years ahead)

event.description: Which day to count down to; custom = your own date

timezone.description: IANA time zone for 'today', e.g. America/New_York

title.description: Name of your own event, used in the sentence (with event=custom)

name: countdown_days_until
title: Countdown API - days until Christmas, New Year, Black Friday or any date
